newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-March copper output up 4.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-March copper output up 4.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China produced 216,300 tonnes on copper in the first quarter, up 4.7 percent from the year-ago period, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday quoting figures from the State Statistical Bureau.
Copper production in March alone was 75,700 tonnes, down 2.45 percent from the adjusted figure for February, the figures showed.

Processed copper products output in March was 78,300 tonnes, with no comparative figure given. Total first quarter output was 181,200 tonnes, up 13.14 percent from the first quarter of 1996, the figures showed.
